notes.title: The Prop Sumo Playtest Begins Now!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699913/7674cface1899bd4e2d6c76c83fb2474344541c8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Are you ready? [b]The Prop Sumo playtest has now begun! 🎊[/b][/p][p]Try out all of Prop Sumo's features, including combat, ultimate abilities, modifiers, progression, customisation, training mode and the tutorial! 💥[/p][p][/p][p]Don't forget to [url="https://discord.gg/qfUHmBbwCK"]join the Prop Sumo Discord[/url] and let us know what you think![/p][p]Still haven't signed up? Get instant access by pressing "Request Access" on the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/"]Prop Sumo Store page[/url]![/p][p][/p][h2][url="https://emojipedia.org/boxing-glove"]🥊[/url] The playtest will run until 29th July, at 5pm UTC.[/h2][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy Prop Sumo! 🙌[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699913/aecfc869ef1b1902fcfa8e8c8223af7704000b18.png"][/img][/p][p]+ Added: You can now jump and move your prop around in the match end screen[/p][p]+ Added: 16 unique looping animations for each individual modifier icon when hovering over a prop in the prop selection screen[/p][p]+ Added: Discord and Support buttons in startup screen and main menu[/p][p]+ Added: Swap ultimate now has its own sounds[/p][p]+ Added: Costs for unlocks on unlock pop up[/p][p]+ Added: Tooltips for customization buttons and session browser entries[/p][p]+ Added: FOV setting[/p][p]+ Added: Setting to disable players names in the world[/p][p]+ Added: new Block VFX[/p][p]+ Added: Visualization for block cooldown on HUD icon and effects[/p][p]+ Added: VFX for recharging your abilities[/p][p]+ Added: Limitations for attachment location, rotation and scale in customization menu[/p][p]+ Added: Support for steam session invites[/p][p]+ Added: Upon Wrecking Ball start and end, any attached mines will explode[/p][p]+ Added: Unsaved changes information and pop up in customization menu[/p][p]+ Added: Credits screen[/p][p]+ Added: Mine now has its own sounds[/p][p]+ Added: Announcer on match start[/p][p]+ Added: Information popup when session creation failed[/p][p]+ Added: 3 videos that appear during tutorial segments
[/p][p]↻ Changed: Redesigned "Prop Sumo" sticker[/p][p]↻ Changed: Replaced placeholder music with new music[/p][p]↻ Changed: Costs for props and ultimates increased (Props now 2 coupons, Ultimates 3 coupons)[/p][p]↻ Changed: Removed Witch scream from the death sound[/p][p]↻ Changed: Ultimate button look and animation now fits better to the prop buttons[/p][p]↻ Changed: Gamma Setting now shows one digit fractional numbers[/p][p]↻ Changed: Matches now end if only one player is left (also for time-based matches)
[/p][p]✓ Fixed: If only one player remains in a party, they will automatically leave the party[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Moved player starts in dojo more towards the center to avoid camera being too close to the prop[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Spectators can no longer fly out of the maps[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Spectators can no longer glitch into the spinning desert rock[/p][p]✓ Fixed: The mine not attaching properly to some surfaces[/p][p]✓ Fixed: End Screen showing more than three players[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Prop scales in End Screen[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Ultimate aiming sound persisted when interrupted[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Item names used in unlock pop up[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Some sounds not being affected by the audio settings[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Magnetize effect not showing sometimes[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Wrecking ball trail effect jittering[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Spawn Grace state visuals not disappearing sometimes[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Collision under lilypad could get players stuck[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Customizations not stopping to jitter sometimes after charging[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Resolution scale starting with LABEL as a default[/p][p]✓ Fixed: Charge indicator now displays correct timings and colours (to match the charge trajectory)[/p]

notes.title: Prop Sumo Playtest Begins 24th July!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45699913/fba1b4cb6f55d9c18ad527e1f331d100ada4fc35.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for your incredible response to the reveal of our brand-new game, [b]Prop Sumo![/b][/p][p]We're extremely excited to get you in-game as soon as possible. 🙌[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🥊 The Prop Sumo playtest will launch on 24th July at 5pm UTC, and run until 29th July at 5pm UTC.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]If you have not already signed up to the free playtest, you can do so on the Prop Sumo Store page:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We hope to see you in-game! Don't forget to join the [url="https://discord.gg/qfUHmBbwCK"]Prop Sumo Discord[/url], too! 💬[/p]

notes.title: Prop Sumo - The Next Chapter in the Witch It Universe!
notes.notes: [p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ygk4a9QB7sw&"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Prop Sumo[/b] is a new multiplayer fighting game [b]from the creators of Witch It![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]For the first time in almost a decade, [b]Barrel Roll Games[/b] is proud to announce a brand new project titled [b]Prop Sumo! [/b]Battle your friends using the props you know and love from [b]Witch It[/b] - unlocking new props, ultimate abilities, and customisation as you progress! 🥊[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/a366bdde7b353ef8fc1e9ce79bc43cc8322de0ef.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Prop Sumo is a [b]physics-driven fighting game[/b] that pits ordinary props together in extraordinary battles. Your goal in Prop Sumo is to be the last prop standing - brawl your opponents with a mixture of different melee moves, combo attacks, and ultimate abilities! 💣[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/2a93b526b14d88f569c60c34505595caad9aa8e3.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]In Prop Sumo, you can shape your playstyle with [b]wild prop modifiers[/b] that transform your ultimate ability in powerful ways! For example: pair the beehive prop with the cannonball ultimate to create a huge explosion that covers your opponents screen in a swarm of bees! Or pair the mandrake with the wrecking ball ultimate to snare your opponents to the ground and crush them! 💥[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/56ff71502c010fc90e25e7ee9c6d5fc7b24baea3.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]There are over [b]100+ ultimate-modifier combinations[/b] that you can experiment with to find the most powerful build! ☄️[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/d54e1724795d5dc3c7e26fa3c97eb55b7b0e8dd2.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Battle on a range of [b]stunning, dynamic maps[/b] built for mayhem! Surging rivers, tangled vines and molten lava will need to be avoided - or used to your advantage! 🔥[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/ef3814baeb0508ac73c6a19348c151bf9154ed6c.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Each round, you'll [b]earn experience and unlock coupons[/b] that can be traded in for new props, ultimate abilities or customisation for your prop. Decorate your prop with a [b]huge selection of cosmetics[/b] that you can fine-tune to match your style! 🧢[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27179238/006038e93aadf2dc408f579a597e999ef213fb1c.jpg"][/img][/h3][p][/p][p]Before we release Prop Sumo to the world, we want to invite you to [b]playtest our game![/b][/p][p][b]To sign up to the Prop Sumo Beta Playtesting phase, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/"]visit the store page[/url], and hit the "Request Access" button! [/b]✔️[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089420/Prop_Sumo/" style="button" buttoncolor="#133358"]Prop Sumo Store Page[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We will be accepting playtesters into Prop Sumo in the coming months, where you'll be able to try out the game for free before it releases later in the year![/p][p]Prop Sumo is peer-to-peer only and best enjoyed with friends. However, we have a server browser so you can jump into matches against strangers too! 🤜🤛[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy [b]Prop Sumo! [/b]✨[/p][p] [b]P.S: Don't forget to join the Prop Sumo Discord server![/b][/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/qfUHmBbwC" style="button" buttoncolor="#0f335c"]Prop Sumo Discord[/url][/p]
